name: Sukoon Joint-On Essential Oil Blend | Natural Pain Relief for Joints, Knees, and Back (30ml)
description:
Experience natural relief with Sukoon Joint-On Essential Oil Blend (30ml) — a powerful formula crafted to ease joint stiffness, swelling, and pain. Infused with a therapeutic blend of natural essential oils, it targets discomfort in knees, back, shoulders, and elbows, offering relief from arthritis, sprains, and muscular strain.
Whether you’re facing pain from daily activity, aging, or sports, Sukoon Joint-On helps restore flexibility, reduce inflammation, and promote faster recovery. Its deep-penetrating formula improves blood circulation and provides lasting comfort — helping you move freely, naturally, and pain-free.
Key Features:
 Relieves joint, back, and knee pain naturally
 Reduces stiffness, swelling, and inflammation
 Eases pain from arthritis, sciatica, and tennis elbow
 Soothes sore muscles, sprains, and strains
 Improves flexibility and joint movement
 Boosts circulation for faster healing
 100% natural essential oil blend
 Suitable for all ages and all skin types
How to Use:
 Apply 5–7 drops of Sukoon Joint-On Oil on affected areas (knees, joints, or back).
 Massage gently until fully absorbed.
 For best results, cover with a warm towel or heating pad for enhanced relief.
 Use 2–3 times daily or as needed.
Caution:
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes and mouth
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs
 Keep out of reach of children
 Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C
 Always perform a patch test before use
Package Includes:
 1 × Sukoon Joint-On Essential Oil Blend (30ml)
